label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), D1 then GO
explanation: Fires only in the final ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (98% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80) and coincides with the value head dropping below ~5.2 (all mass in the lowest value bin), so it acts as an end-of-episode / remaining-horizon clock. Within those trials it fires mostly at D1 (85% of mass), with activation growing trial by trial toward the episode end; GO joins only in the last few trials. D1 with a reward shown (in_rew=1) fires more often than unrewarded D1. Essentially never at D2. Mild bias toward a2 / S2-good episodes. Predicate uses only observed timing (episode position is inferable by the agent); precision is limited because the onset trial varies between episodes, so it is a ramp, not a clean on/off unit. Magnitude increases with ep_trial (checked in example windows).
